reviewer: English source-alignment reviewer, separate from original edition author

changes.before: A value-source is the structural ground by which a bearer, at some structural level, makes a class of concrete content able to enter the field of end-value.
changes.after: A value-source is the structural ground by which a bearer, at some structural position, makes a class of concrete content able to enter the field of end-value.
changes.reason: The definition says 结构位, not 层级; preserve the position/level distinction.

changes.before: A value-source is a structural ground, given with the bearer's structural level. Concrete value-content is the appearance of a source, in some bearer, at some moment; it can arise and pass. A particular preference is the bearer's content-choice at this moment; it can be mistaken, can change, can be hijacked, and being chosen does not by itself make it a value-source. Direction-value is an orientation-reading of a transformation, appraising the transformation and not the bearer; it belongs to Power Theory. Price is the market reading of exchange and common measure; it belongs to Economics.
changes.after: A value-source is a structural ground, given with the bearer's structural position. Concrete value-content is the appearance of a source, in some bearer, at some moment; it can arise and pass. A particular preference is the bearer's content-choice at this moment; it can be mistaken, can change, can be hijacked, and being chosen does not by itself make it a value-source. Direction-value is an orientation-reading of a transformation, appraising the transformation and not the bearer; it belongs to Power Theory. Price is the market reading of exchange and common measure; it belongs to Economics.
changes.reason: Preserve 结构位 as structural position.

changes.before: Now the structured end. To delete the outside lateral ruler is to delete only the instrument of ranking, not the structure. A value-source is not something a bearer declares offhand; it is given with the bearer's structural level. Who can bear has its conditions. How a content appears out of a source, is avowed, is socially recognized, has its layers. How an outside end counterfeits one's own value has an auditable criterion. What a subject happens to like at this moment is a particular preference, and does not become a value-source by that fact.
changes.after: Now the structured end. To delete the outside lateral ruler is to delete only the instrument of ranking, not the structure. A value-source is not something a bearer declares offhand; it is given with the bearer's structural position. Who can bear has its conditions. How a content appears out of a source, is avowed, is socially recognized, has its layers. How an outside end counterfeits one's own value has an auditable criterion. changes.reason: Preserve 结构位 as structural position.

changes.before: No gate — an animal. It does not bear end-value. It has its experience, and the good and ill of that experience are real; but the way that good and ill enters the field of value is by being projected in, one-way, by a higher-level subject who takes it as an end of its own care and giving.
changes.after: No gate — an animal. It does not bear end-value. It has its experience, and the good and ill of that experience are real; but the way that good and ill enters the field of value is by being projected in, one-way, by a higher-level subject who takes it as the recipient of its own concern and giving.
changes.reason: 一端 means the receiving side here, not status as an end, which this paragraph expressly denies.

changes.before: To take the circle apart, the first step is to lift good and ill out of experience and off the value judgment.
changes.after: To take the circle apart, the first step is to separate the good and ill within experience from value judgment.
changes.reason: The Chinese separates experiential polarity from valuation; it does not remove polarity from experience itself.

changes.before: Row one: the orientability of experience. Derived in the section above — valence acquiring trans-temporal orientability through memory and prediction, becoming a structure of what is worth maintaining, repeating or avoiding. The orientation is inward, toward the bearer's own experience.
changes.after: Row one: the orientability of experience. Derived in the section above — valence acquiring trans-temporal orientability through memory and prediction, becoming a structure of what is worth maintaining, repeating or avoiding. The source in this row is precisely this structural position enabling a class of content to be borne as end-value. The orientation is inward, toward the bearer's own experience.
changes.reason: Restore the omitted sentence identifying the structural ground that permits content to be borne as end-value.

changes.before: So this layer not only fails to collide with the prequel; the two confirm each other. The prequel says value asks for one bearer only; this says the vacancy thrown off by that sole bearer is formal and self-sufficient while empty. Two sides of one thing.
changes.after: So this layer not only fails to collide with the prequel; the two confirm each other. The prequel says value asks for one bearer only; this says the vacancy thrown off by that sole bearer is formal, and the bearer remains self-sufficient while it stands empty. Two sides of one thing.
changes.reason: Self-sufficiency belongs to the bearer, not to the formal vacancy.

disposition: Retain the existing complete English edition with seven localized corrections. All 206 units read against Chinese, including no-ranking versus numerical equality, four bearer/gate cases, memory/prediction derivation, autonomy and modal limits, formal other-place, three-layer acknowledgment bridge and relational non-merger. No wholesale retranslation.
limitations: Source alignment, not a new philosophical proof or independent factual audit.
